## Bottom line
**Suggests Invasive (99%)** · Confident · Careful review
Tier-1 surgical frozen section with single-class conformal set [F1] and positive margins [F7], though top neighbor is InSitu.

## Confidence
| Signal | Value | Reading |
|---|---|---|
| Top probabilities | Invasive 99%, InSitu 1%, Benign 0%, Normal 0% (ECE 5%) | Strong invasive score; small test set |
| Conformal set | {Invasive}, 10% alpha (90% test coverage) | Single class at dataset guarantee |
| Reliability / OOD | 98% reliability, 96th-percentile OOD, 12/12 regions [F6] (JPEG-3; AUROC 70%) | Passes QC; near distribution edge |
| CONCH–MUSK agreement | Agree with each other | Independent backbones pick same class |
| Similar cases | 3/5 Invasive (60%) [F5]; 2/5 InSitu (BACH_0241, 85%) | Mixed neighborhood; closest match InSitu |

## Tissue evidence
- **Tumor infiltrating stroma** (regions 0, 4) · ↑ invasive · Above-typical (+0.54 contribution), pushes toward invasive [F2] · Validated
- **Gland / tubule formation** (regions 3, 10, 11) · ↓ invasive · Above-typical (-0.37 contribution), pulls against invasive [F3] · Weak
- **Normal lobules with two-layered epithelium** (region 4) · ↑ invasive · Typical (+0.30 contribution); 0/20 AI spot check [F4] · Unreliable
- **Dense lymphocytic infiltrate (TILs)** (region 4) · context · Descriptive (+0.15 contribution); differs from InSitu neighbor BACH_0241 · Weak

## Trust check
- **Heatmap**: Faithful; deleting top-3 risk regions drops invasive score beyond random (+0.011, 95% CI +0.002 to +0.020).
- **Concepts**: Unproven faithfulness (+0.001 vs random, 95% CI -0.009 to +0.006); uses Unreliable normal lobules (0/20), mitoses, necrosis.

## Could be wrong if
- Top neighbor BACH_0241 (85% similarity) is InSitu, and tubules (regions 3, 10, 11) reflect in situ disease.
- Severity-3 JPEG degradation and 96th-percentile OOD distort frozen-section embeddings or positive calls across all four margins.

## Check on the slide
1. **Regions 8, 6, 7, 9, 0, 4**: Confirm stromal invasion in highest-risk heatmap and concept regions.
2. **Regions 3, 10, 11**: Distinguish invasive tubules from duct-confined in situ carcinoma.
3. **Regions 0–4, 7–11**: Verify tumor at superior/inferior (430 um), lateral (323 um), medial (108 um) margins.
